Hi Alex — thanks for the heads-up and for the attachments. Sorry you're seeing the blank join link. We've seen this happen when an organizer is a guest on the host calendar (GCal re-writes organizer metadata) and the meeting platform token doesn't propagate to attendees.

Quick plan:
- I'll resend a clean invite from our hosted calendar (Ben Carter) rather than forwarding.
- I can also create a temporary Zoom meeting link right now so your team can join if you want to keep the 8/28 time.
- If the calendar shows duplicate events after I send, please keep the one that lists "Organized by: Ben Carter (redwood.com)" — that's the canonical event.

Proposed temp Zoom (use this if needed): https://zoom.us/j/999888777 (passcode: RedwoodDemo)

I'll copy Jordan and Naomi from ops to help with the ICS token swap if needed. Sending a fresh invite in a minute.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Ben — looped Jordan and Naomi since this looks like an ICS organizer token issue we've been fixing. Jordan can you inspect the outbound ICS payload for the 8/28 event and ensure the x-platform headers (zoom/join token) are included and not being stripped when GCal rewrites the organizer?

Jordan — if you can't fix it quickly, please advise on a follow-up cadence (we should avoid making the customer accept multiple duplicate events). Naomi — please stand by to resend a canonical invite from ben.carter@redwood.com and include a short note explaining which event to keep.

If it's helpful I can call Mediacorp scheduling directly, but prefer to try the token swap first.

Thanks,
